title: Daande Luulndiinde Laamu Idol
intro: Ina jeyaa e nelaaɓe Joom baawɗe oo, maccuɗo tiiɗɗo ummiɗo e nder leñol tiiɗngol ngam yettinde goonga. Leñol maɓɓe ƴettiino laamɗo peewnaaɗo, ruttaade e Tagɗo ko woodi fof. E pellital ngal 6eydaani, oo necfcfo noddi 6e — kono nulal ngal hawri e yeddude e ja6de. Ɗaɓɓu e nder nate ngam yiytude hol ooɗoo maccuɗo dewondirɗo.
clues: Mi neldaama nulaaɗo e leñol tiiɗngol, ngol woɗɗi laawol peewal.
Mi arii siftinde leñol am tagɗo ko woodi fof — ɓurɗo tagooɓe fof.
Leñol am ngol wayliima e sanamuuji fenaande ɗi ɓe teddini, ɗi ɓe noddirta jamma e ñalawma.
Miɗo luulndii ɓe e cuusal, miɗo naamnoo hol ko waɗi ɓe ndewa laamɗo peewnaaɗo, ɓe ngoppa Joomiraawo maɓɓe goonga.
Ɓe njeddi kam, ɓe calii heɗaade, ɓe njokkii e fenaande maɓɓe — kono Joomiraawo am ina reeni kam.
Miin woni Ilyas — jam hokkaama e am, mi limtaama e maccuɓe gooŋɗinɓe Yurmeende.
